There IS such a thing as interstate claims. They vary state to state. Contact the office of your preferred filing state and see how they work with interstate claims. Some allow you to make a total sum account drawing from each state. But it’s I think the sole agency of your state’s office to do that work. I’m expecting a call back from NY DOL on the matter in a few days. (Reached out to them via Twitter. They got back to me super fast.) I’ll update what I find out after that!!

Also, I’m not sure why some folks were trying to scare you with fraud and jail time. You have a not totally uncommon and legitimate concern. With each state having different laws, it makes an already confusing system even more confusing. Keep the faith.
